# India Fintech Risk Atlas
> An open, source-cited reference for Indian fintech (UPI, Cards, PA/PG, Lending) fraud patterns, controls, and operational risks.

## About
- Source: https://github.com/eyeinthesky6/india-fintech-risk-atlas
- Live Documentation: https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/
- API / JSON Dataset: https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/atlas-records.json
- MCP Server: india-fintech-risk-atlas-mcp
- Evidence Layers: Regulatory (RBI/NPCI), Industry practice, Community insight, Research & academic, Atlas guidance

## Canonical Risk Records
- [UPI-OVERVIEW] UPI ecosystem and participant roles: UPI-OVERVIEW — system architecture, participant boundaries, and asymmetric risk telemetry. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/upi-ecosystem/) - Layers: official, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-001] Unusual outbound payment velocity: UPI-001 — account-level outbound burst and rapid balance-depletion signals. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/unusual-outbound-velocity/) - Layers: official, research, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-002] Potential mule-account funnel: UPI-002 — pass-through layering networks, RBIH MuleHunter.AI / I4C coordination, and relational detection limits. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/mule-account-funnel/) - Layers: official, research, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-003] Account takeover and device-binding risk: UPI-003 — unauthorized account/device compromise, SIM/device binding, and post-change cooling periods. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/account-takeover/) - Layers: official, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-004] Collect-request deception: UPI-004 — social engineering around payment direction, P2P collect discontinuation, and P2M pull controls. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/collect-request-deception/) - Layers: official, industry, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-005] Payment status and order reconciliation: UPI-005 — merchant/PA payment status, webhook authenticity, idempotency, and order-fulfilment reconciliation. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/payment-status-reconciliation/) - Layers: official, industry, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-006] QR and fake cashback deception: UPI-006 — social engineering via deceptive QR codes, cashback claims, and tampered payment links. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/qr-cashback-deception/) - Layers: official, industry, research, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-007] Fake support and grievance impersonation: UPI-007 — search-result, social-media, and bogus call-centre impersonation around refunds and failed payments. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/fake-support-impersonation/) - Layers: official, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-008] Untrusted app and remote-access risk: UPI-008 — sideloaded APKs, screen mirroring, remote-access coercion, and mobile RASP controls. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/untrusted-app-access/) - Layers: official, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-009] Authentication and payment authorization: UPI-009 — multi-factor authentication, dynamic factors, exemptions, and issuer responsibility. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/authentication-context/) - Layers: official, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-010] Transaction velocity and EFRM monitoring: UPI-010 — regulatory Enterprise Fraud Risk Management (EFRM) architecture, alert parameterization, staff calibration, and feedback loops. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/transaction-velocity/) - Layers: official, industry, research, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-011] Repeated failed authentication attempts: UPI-011 — detecting credential stuffing, wrong-PIN probing, lockouts, and customer alerts. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/failed-authentication/) - Layers: official, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-012] Merchant onboarding and classification: UPI-012 — Payment Aggregator KYC/CDD, MCC classification, acquiring bank oversight, and transaction laundering risks. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/merchant-onboarding/) - Layers: official, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-013] UPI dispute and complaint routing: UPI-013 — RBI Online Dispute Resolution (ODR), PA chargeback/dispute flows, and separating failed vs. fraudulent incidents. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/dispute-routing/) - Layers: official, industry, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-014] Settlement and reconciliation exceptions: UPI-014 — interbank settlement-file reconciliation, failed-transaction TATs, and scheme exception handling. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/settlement-exceptions/) - Layers: official, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-015] Unauthorized and fraudulent transaction customer protection: UPI-015 — customer liability allocation, burden of proof, 2026–2027 commercial-bank amendments vs. payments-bank baseline. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/customer-liability/) - Layers: official, atlas | Stage: source-checked
- [UPI-016] Digital payment fraud safeguards under discussion: UPI-016 — RBI's April 2026 Discussion Paper on lagged credit, trusted-person verification, KYC credit checks, and kill switches. (https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/risk-discussion/) - Layers: official, atlas | Stage: source-checked

## Documentation & Policies
- [Methodology](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/methodology/): Methodology
- [Evidence and attribution policy](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/evidence-policy/): How the Atlas puts reference facts first and separates Regulatory, Industry practice, Community insight, Research & academic, and Atlas guidance layers.
- [Contribute](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/contribute/): Contribute
- [Licensing and reuse](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/licensing/): What can be reused and what remains the property of its original publisher.
- [UPI Risk-Stack Playbook](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/risk-stack-playbook/): End-to-end engineering guidance across prevention, detection, monitoring, investigation, reconciliation, disputes, customer impact and feedback loops.
- [Operator Insights & Evidence](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/operator-insights/): Company-reported payment engineering docs (Industry practice) alongside empirical Research & academic studies.
- [UPI Risk Glossary](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/glossary/): Core terms, participant roles, regulatory concepts, and operational distinctions across India's UPI ecosystem.
- [Verified Primary Sources Register](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/sources/): Verified RBI regulatory texts, NPCI circular status, and research references for UPI risk controls.
- [Coverage & Review Status](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/coverage/): What the UPI compendium includes, which records are source-checked, and what release blockers remain.
- [UPI Ecosystem](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/upi-ecosystem/): UPI-OVERVIEW — system architecture, participant boundaries, and asymmetric risk telemetry.
